summary: Quest-ready alerts, optional automatic accept and turn-in, a current-zone filter, party progress and reward sell prices.
description: Forever Quests plays a sound and prints a message when a quest becomes ready to turn in or an objective is finished. A quest that is ready also gets a QUEST COMPLETE banner on the screen (click it to see where to turn the quest in) and a COMPLETED mark at the top of its zone in the quest log. It can accept and turn in quests for you (both off by default; hold Shift to skip it once), and it never picks a reward when a quest offers a choice. It can show only the quests of your current zone, in the quest log and in the tracker. A quest that makes progress goes to the top of its zone in the quest log and glows for a few seconds, and the quests of each zone can be sorted by name. The quest tracker at the right of the screen gets the same look and order: a ready quest is a green row, and a quest that makes progress goes to the top and glows. Beside the details of a quest it lists the items of the quest: the item to use, the items to collect, the rewards and the choice of rewards, whether they are in your bags or not. It shows the vendor sell price of each reward choice, and shares objective progress with party members who also use it. It also counts the quests, experience and money you earn from turn-ins. Change the settings in the game's Options window or type /fq.
